类 ProgressStyle

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressStyle
public final class ProgressStyle extends Object
Character set used to draw the bar itself.

All characters are single BMP characters on purpose: this keeps width calculations identical on JDK 8 and JDK 28 and avoids surrogate-pair counting differences between terminals.

  • 构造器详细资料

    • ProgressStyle

      public ProgressStyle(char complete, char head, char pending)
      Creates a style with default [ and ] delimiters.
      参数:
      complete - character for completed cells
      head - character for the leading edge, or '\0' for none
      pending - character for remaining cells

    • ProgressStyle

      public ProgressStyle(char complete, char head, char pending, String prefix, String suffix)
      Creates a style with explicit delimiters.
      参数:
      complete - character for completed cells
      head - character for the leading edge, or '\0' for none
      pending - character for remaining cells
      prefix - text before the bar, or null for none
      suffix - text after the bar, or null for none
